subject: Meridian Operational Update: Ticket INC-2026-SHAKTI-01 [shakti cement plant ltd]
body:
[Notification Letter]
Subject: Immediate Action Required for Shakti Cement Load Due to Vehicle Breakdown

To: Operations Manager, Shakti Cement Plant Ltd.
From: Meridian Freight Dispatch Team
Date: [Insert Current Date]

Dear Sir/Madam,

This is to inform you of the critical breakdown that occurred on our route from Gurgaon to Ludhiana (42.0 km) involving a vehicle with the registration number UP40IM3144, which is a BharatBenz 2823R model manufactured in 2022 and operating under BS Stage BS6 standards.

The breakdown was due to transmission failure and smoking engine issues on National Highway 44 (NH44). The vehicle was carrying 28 tons of cement. This situation falls under a critical breakdown severity level, necessitating immediate action.

We have assigned the replacement vehicle with registration number HR16SP9238, which is an Ashok Leyland 3520 model manufactured in 2024 and operating under BS Stage BS6 standards. The replacement vehicle will be dispatched from our hub in Gurgaon to ensure a timely delivery of your cement load.

Please confirm receipt of this notification and coordinate the necessary arrangements for the replacement vehicle's dispatch as soon as possible. Failure to do so may result in significant delays, which could have adverse effects on your operations.

Should you require any further information or assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us at [Your Contact Information].

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Meridian Freight Dispatch Team
[Your Contact Information]
